study: Zero-update transfer of frozen MuSiQue sign-readout models
scientific_gap: The one-draw sensitivity reused a 256-question evaluation and the eight-draw selected Majority comparison changes after validation shrinkage. The fixed models need evaluation on additional questions and on true support paths.
scope: Three-hop strict chains in already cached MuSiQue-Ans train/dev. Historical native models used the entire labeled source. No official QA evaluation. The public test has no annotated paths. New means unused by both controlled sign-readout studies.
inclusion: Distinct normalized composed question and corpus ID outside all train, selection and evaluation manifests of both November controlled studies. Three distinct normalized gold texts. Step j>1 must refer exactly to step j-1. No choice based on model outcomes.
tiers: All tiers first exclude every prior controlled question or ID. Middle additionally excludes shared decomposition IDs, normalized subquestions or normalized gold text. Full additionally excludes candidate-to-prior-support and support-to-prior-candidate overlap in both directions. History contains all splits of both controlled studies together.
sampling: Use SHA256 order of salt reviewer-20261121-3hop and official identifier, globally deduplicate normalized question with dev before train. Take at most 512 questions per tier per official source. Pool the fully purged cohorts for the primary result. Always report tier sizes including zero, question-only results separately by source, and source-stratified comparisons. If full purge yields zero questions, the primary estimate is unavailable; remaining results are explicitly weaker.
frozen_comparators: Reuse the exact E5 feature code, BGE snapshot, four frozen-base family, recorded validation-selected bases, raw trained weights, and selected multipliers from both five-seed locked protocols. No retraining, validation, rate selection, or shrinkage selection. Reuse selected control, E5, final only, +C1, +I1, all indices. Score all four existing 3-hop readouts.
primary: On fully purged three-hop questions, signed difference-in-differences in exact Majority error: (I1 minus C1 at eight training draws) minus (I1 minus C1 at one training draw), at the validation-selected scale. Negative favors a larger index advantage after eight draws.
secondary: Within each training draw count, compare I1 minus C1 on clean answer error, annotated ordered complete path EM and unordered support-set F1. Repeat at raw full residual scale and compare final, each auxiliary and all-index against frozen. Report per-seed and per-question variation. First, Last and Parity are fixed secondary readouts.
inference: Exact Rademacher risk under greedy distinct-index rollout, independent exhaustive-sign implementation for Majority. The identical 5 trained seeds are paired. Use percentile intervals from 5000 bootstrap draws of questions within official source after averaging paired seeds, conditional on frozen seeds. On qualifying nontrivial cohorts, additionally cluster by normalized first gold-support text, retaining a question-weighted ratio. Intervals pointwise and exploratory except the registered primary.
reported_training_cost: 0 epochs, 0 new training or selection labels; human support annotations in held-out records are used to define and evaluate outcomes.
source_audit: Count previously exposed official train/dev rows via legacy run manifests and official released labels available on test; enumerate answerable Full archive records only for identity checks, without deriving hidden test labels.
